text: Thornico is a family-owned conglomerate that took its form around the millennium, when father and son Thor and Christian Nicholas Stadil secured their investments in hummel; its group structure lists hummel under Sport & Fashion.
short: hummel is part of the Stadil family's Thornico group.

source.name: THORNICO: About THORNICO - A family-owned conglomerate
source.quote: A FAMILY-OWNED CONGLOMERATE THORNICO - the name combination of Thor and Nicholas - took its form around the millennium where father and son, Thor and Christian Nicholas Stadil, secured their investments in hummel
